taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: API Gateway authorizer cache key and generated policy scope
controls.source_trace: Trace a cached authorization result across method/resource/tenant differences. For IAM policies inspect resource scope; for HTTP API simple responses inspect route-varying allow reuse.
controls.implementation_branch: Branch first on REST API versus HTTP API and authorizer payload version. REST decisions can return scoped IAM policies; HTTP API v2 simple responses can return isAuthorized without any Resource policy. For each mode inspect identity sources, route-key inclusion, TTL and backend checks. Reusing an allow result matters only if a forbidden route/effect is then accepted.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned gateway fixture compare fresh and cached requests for two synthetic routes with different entitlements.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An authorizer cache hit is expected; establish a forbidden backend action or data result rather than only skipped authorizer logs.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Align cache identity and mode-specific decision scope, including route-key identity when required; preserve authorized reuse and the declared revocation interval.
